cim: Côte d’Ivoire trains public sector leaders on artificial intelligence and digital transformation
cim_eredeti: Côte d’Ivoire trains public sector leaders on artificial intelligence and digital transformation
szoveg_eredeti:
Côte d’Ivoire’s Ministry of Digital Transition and Technological Innovation has organised two training sessions on artificial intelligence (AI) for senior public sector leaders, as part of efforts to strengthen the capacity of public institutions to manage technological change and accelerate the digital transformation of public administration.

The training sessions were held on Thursday, November 26, 2026, in Abidjan, in partnership with aivancity, a French higher education institution specialising in artificial intelligence and data.

The sessions brought together presidents, senior executives and directors of structures under the ministry’s supervision in the presence of Djibril Ouattara, Minister of Digital Transition and Technological Innovation.

The initiative focused on two complementary dimensions of AI adoption: the strategic understanding of the technology by public sector leaders and its practical applications in the operations of public institutions.

The first session, led by Dr. Tawhid Chtioui, founding president of aivancity, examined the economic and societal transformations driven by artificial intelligence.

Discussions also addressed digital sovereignty, ethics, governance and accountability, particularly the considerations that accompany the deployment of AI in public institutions.

The second session focused on the operational applications of artificial intelligence in organisational activities, including data analysis, strategic monitoring, document production, decision support and project monitoring.

Participants also explored the potential of generative and agentic artificial intelligence in improving organisational processes and supporting public sector performance.

According to the ministry, the initiative reflects an ambition to make artificial intelligence a true lever for the modernisation and performance of Ivorian public administration.

It added that the objective is to build an administration that is better equipped, more efficient and capable of fully leveraging technological innovations while ensuring the responsible use of AI in the public interest and in service of citizens.
